card.name: Scattered label phrases, intracranial and including
card.fires_on: Fires on the "ial" ending of "intracranial" in warnings about CO2 retention, and on "including" after "severe hepatic injury," in NSAID warnings. It also fires weakly on a few word pieces such as "IN" in CLINICAL.

modes.label: Intracranial ending
modes.description: The closing piece "ial" of "intracranial" in a warning about CO2 retention.
modes.example: In patients who may be susceptible to the intracran<<ial>> effects of CO 2 retention (e

modes.label: Including after hepatic injury
modes.description: The word "including" introducing a list of liver conditions in an NSAID warning.
modes.example: cases of severe hepatic injury,<< including>> fulminant hepatitis, liver necrosis

modes.label: Partway through capitalized words
modes.description: A piece inside an all-caps word, such as a section name or cross-reference.

card.plain: It marks a few specific spots in label warnings, such as the end of "intracranial" and "including" before liver injury terms.
